titulo: Using o sea / es decir to clarify, explain and express a consequence
subtitulo: Mañana es lunes, o sea, de vuelta a la rutina.
regla: O sea (casual) and es decir (formal) introduce a clarification or a consequence: in other words, that is, so. They never change.

bloques.texto: To add an **explanation**, a **clarification** or a **consequence** of what you just said, use **o sea** or **es decir**.
Both are fixed: they never change.
**O sea** often brings **que** with it when it introduces a consequence: **o sea, que tengo tiempo**.
In writing they usually go between commas.
Tip: **o sea** is for the taquería, **es decir** for the contract.

lista.es: Mañana es lunes, ==o sea==, de regreso a la rutina.
lista.en: Tomorrow is Monday, in other words, back to the routine.

lista.es: Al final salí temprano, ==o sea, que== tengo tiempo para una cerveza.
lista.en: In the end I got off early, so I have time for a beer.

lista.es: Vi a Carlos con otra chava, ==o sea, que== le está poniendo el cuerno.
lista.en: I saw Carlos with another girl, which means he's cheating on her.

lista.es: Estudiaremos las culturas prehispánicas, ==es decir==, antes de la llegada de Colón.
lista.en: We'll study pre-Hispanic cultures, that is, before Columbus arrived.

lista.es: Deben firmar en las dos páginas, ==es decir==, en la página dos y en la cuatro.
lista.en: You must sign both pages, that is, pages two and four.

lista.es: El paquete incluye media pensión, ==es decir==, desayuno y cena.
lista.en: The package includes half board, that is, breakfast and dinner.

lista.nota: In a formal document, **es decir** sounds better than **o sea**.

lista.texto: Other connectors: [[8796|on the one hand, on the other]].
**O sea** comes from **ser** in the subjunctive: [[5152|ser in the subjunctive]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Casual: _I'm broke, I mean, I can't go._
lista.r: Estoy sin dinero, o sea, no puedo ir.

lista.p: Formal: _Payment is due on the 1st, that is, next Monday._
lista.r: El pago vence el día 1, es decir, el próximo lunes.

lista.p: Which one fits a chat with Beto? **o sea** or **es decir**?
